content: Pobholia

Kasiimpo o Isa abholi tampa incia sumai tee alingka aporope i poropinsi Yudea tee i lipu i wetana timbuna Umala Yordan. Mia bhari aumba alibutia, kasiimpo Isa aadhari manga mia bhari sumai mboomo kananeana.
Sabutuna aumbamo manga mia mominaakana i rombongana Farisi to acobai Isa tee aabha, "Amembali buaka samia umane abholi bhawinena?"
Lawanina Isa, "Opea iparintaakana Nabii Musa to ingkomiu?"
Manga incia apogau, "Musa aundaakea o mia apobholi tee bhawinena maka tabeana aporikana aburi sura kabhotu."
Pogauna Isa tee manga incia, "Roonamo kakaana incamiu sabutuna aburimea o parinta incia sumai to ingkomiu.
Maka minaaka i auwalina dunia sii, Aulataʼala 'apadhaangia umane tee bhawine.'
'Rampaakanamo alasa incia sii, samia umane bheabholi amana tee inana, tee adhadhi aposaangu tee bhawinena
sabutuna rua miaia amembali asaangu bada.' Tee mboo sumai, manga incia mencuanamo rua mia, maka saangu.
Rampaakanamo sumai, opea mopadhana ipaposaanguna Aulataʼala, ancosala apapogaaia maanusia."
Sapesuana Isa tee manga murina i bhanua, manga murina abhaakamo uka pendua o hali incia sumai i Incia.
Kasiimpo o Isa apogau, "Incema mobholina bhawinena kasiimpo akawi tee bhawine mosagaanana, maʼanana incia apewau zina tee bhawinena.
Mboo sumai uka tee bhawine mobholina umanena. Ande incia akawi tee umane mosagaanana, incia uka apewau zina."
Isa Aemani Barakati to Manga Anaana
Kasiimpo dhaangia tee mia mobhawana manga anaana i Isa, tee aharapu mamudhaakana manga anaana sumai adhingkua Isa, maka manga murina agorampangi manga mia incia sumai.

Wakutuuna Isa akamata giu incia sumai, Incia aʼamara tee apogau, "Taroakamea manga anaana sumai aumba i Iaku. Bholi ujoli-jolia, roonamo manga miamo mboo sumai momembalina uumatina Pamarintana Aulataʼala.
Satotuuna Iaku kupogau tee ingkomiu, incema-incema inda motarimana Pamarintana Aulataʼala mboomo anaana maidhiidhi tee apaporitambe karona, incia inda bheamembali apesua i nuncana."
Kasiimpo o Isa asaku manga anaana sumai, apoose adhikaakea limana i bhawona bhaana samia-samia tee aemaniakea barakati to manga incia.
Mia Morangkaea Anarakaa Apesua i Nuncana Pamarintana Aulataʼala

Wakutuuna Isa apalausaka lingkaana, dhaangia samia o mia mobuntulina moumbana i Incia kasiimpo asuju i aroana tee aabha, "E Guru momalape, opea tabeana ipewauku mamudhaakana kupotibhaaka dhadhi mobakaa?"
Isa apogau, "Apokia usarongiaku kumalape? Inda dhaangia samia uka momalapena, tabeana Sakaro-karona Aulataʼala momalapena.
Ingkoo umataumea manga parintana Aulataʼala: Bholi upekamate mia, bholi uzina, bholi umanako, bholi udhawu kasakusii gau-gau, bholi utipu mia mosagaanana, tee uhoromatia o amamu tee inamu."
Apogaumo o mia sumai tee Isa, "E Guru, bhari-bharia parinta incia sumai padhamo kuosea apepuu minaaka kumaidhiidhi."

Kasiimpo Isa atonto mia incia sumai tee abukeaka kaasina incana tee apogau, "Dhaangia saangupo indapo ipewaumu. Mbulimo, asomea bhari-bharia harataa pewauamu, kasiimpo udhawuakea o doina hasilina pewauamu sumai i mia misikini, sumaimo ingkoo bheupotibhaaka harataa mobakaa i sorogaa. Sapadhana incia sumai, mbulimo iwe sii tee uosemo Iaku."
Sarangona pogau incia sumai, incia amaidhiidhimo incana tee alingkamo minaaka i iwe sumai, roonamo incia abhari o harataana.
Kasiimpo o Isa apotonto i saripina tee apogau i manga murina, "Amarasai mpuu o mia morangkaea apesua i nuncana uumatina Pamarintana Aulataʼala!"
Manga murina amente arango pogauna Isa sumai. Kasiimpo Isa apogau uka, "E manga anaku, amarasai mpuu to mia apesua i nuncana Pamarintana Aulataʼala!
Alabhi amamudha sambaa unta apesua i bhalona sorumba tee samia o mia morangkaea apesua i nuncana Pamarintana Aulataʼala."
Sarangona pogauna Isa sumai, manga murina sahandana amente, tee apoabha-abhakimo podho-podho manga incia, "Ande mboo sumai, incema momembalina ipasalaamati?"
Isa atonto manga incia tee apogau, "Maanusia inda amembali apasalaamati karona, maka o Aulataʼala momembalina mopasalaamatina maanusia, roonamo Aulataʼala amembali apewau opeapo uka."
Ponambona Taose Isa
Kasiimpo apogaumo o Petrus tee Isa, "Ingkami tabholimea bhari-bharia pewauamami to taose Ingkoo!"
Pogauna Isa, "Satotuuna Iaku kupogau tee ingkomiu, mia mobholina bhanuana, witinaina umane, witinaina bhawine, amana, inana, manga anana, atawa o inawuna roonamo Iaku tee rampaakanamo Lele Malape,

sumaimo i wakutuu incia sii uka incia bheapotibhaaka saatu kali lipa: manga bhanua, witinai umane, witinai bhawine, ina, anaana, tee inawu moomini incia anamisi pegiu-giuna kanarakaa. Sainamo i zamani bhemoumbana naile itu, incia bheapotibhaaka dhadhi mobakaa.

Maka naile itu, abhari o mia mokokauncuramakana momalanga sii-sii bheapotibhaaka kauncuramaka moporitambena mpuu, tee abhari o mia mokokauncuramakana moporitambe sii-sii bheapotibhaaka kauncuramaka momalangana mpuu."
Kapaumbaakana I Talu Mpearona to Kanarakaana Isa

Wakutuuna Isa tee manga murina tangasaana i nuncana lingkaana alingka i Yerusalem, Incia alingka aporiaroa, sainamo manga mia moosea i talikuna. Manga murina amente, tee manga mia moosea mosagaanana uka amaeka. Isa akemba sapulu rua miaia murina tee apekalino minaaka i manga mia moosea, kasiimpo apepuumo apakoleleaka opea bhemomembalina tee karona.

Pogauna Isa, "Sii-sii ingkita tapene i Yerusalem. Iwe sumai o Anana Maanusia bheatopasaraakaaka i manga imamu maoge, tee i manga ahalii Hukumu Taurati, to bheatohukumu mate, tee bheapasaraakaakea i limana manga mia inda motolentuna miana Yahudi.
Incia bheatoele-ele, atowiluki, atosambi, tee atohukumu mate. Maka talu eo sapadhana sumai Incia bheadhadhi pendua."
Iemanina Yakub tee Yahya
Mencuana Apekaparinta maka Alaiani
Kasiimpo manga anana Zabdi, siitumo Yakub tee Yahya, apasari i Isa tee apogau, "E Guru, ingkami taharapu mamudhaakana upewau opea iemanimami."
Lawanina Isa, "Opea iemanimiu bhekupewau to ingkomiu?"
Manga incia apogau, "E Guru, mangaundaakamo to tauncura i nuncana kamuliangimu naile itu, samia auncura i weta kaanamu tee samiana uka auncura i weta kaaimu."
Maka o Isa apogau, "Ingkomiu inda umataua opea iemanimiu. Buaka ingkomiu umembali usumpu antona tonde bheisumpuku, atawa utopapebhaho tee kapapebhahoka bheitarimaku?"
Manga incia alawani, "Ingkami tamembali." Isa apogau, "Umbe, ingkomiu dhaanamo bheusumpu antona tonde bheisumpuku, tee ingkomiu uka bheutopapebhaho tee kapapebhahoka bheitarimaku.

Maka o soʼalina uuncura i weta kaana tee uuncura i weta kaaiku, mencuana Iaku mokohakuna modhawuakakomiu, roonamo Amaku apasiapuaka tampa incia sumai to manga incia mopadhana ipasiapuakana to mouncuramikia."
Wakutuuna sapulu mia murina mosagaanana arango hali incia sumai, manga incia apepuumo aʼamara tee Yakub tee Yahya.

Kasiimpo Isa akemba manga incia tee apogau, "Ingkomiu umataua, manga incia isarongiaka kapalana manga lipu bheaparintangi raʼeatina tee kakaana incana, tee manga kaogesana akokuasa mpuu tee apisaki raʼeatina.
Maka ingkomiu bholi upewau mboo sumai. Incema-incema gauna amembali momaogena i tanga-tangamiu, incia tabeana amembali mia molaianikomiu,
tee incema-incema gauna bheamembali mia momalangana kauncuramakana i tanga-tangamiu, incia tabeana amembali bhatuamiu.
Roonamo Anana Maanusia aumba mencuana to atolaiani, maka to alaiani mia mosagaanana tee apasaraakaaka inyawana to amembali katolosina mia bhari."
Isa Apaunto Kapiina Bartimeus

Kasiimpo Isa tee manga murina akawamo i kota Yerikho. Wakutuuna Incia apobhawa tee manga murina, tee abhari uka o mia moosea alimba minaaka i kota incia sumai, dhaangia samia o pande pengkaemani momawilo mokosaroakana Bartimeus bin Timeus tangasaana auncura i bhiwina dhala.
Sarangona ande dhaangia tee Isa miana Nazaret sumai, incia apepuumo akakee-kee, "E Isa, e Anana Daud, maasiakaakupo!"
Abhari o mia mogorampangia mamudhaakana bholi amarobho, maka incia sahandana amakaa apekee, "E Anana Daud, maasiakaakupo!"
Sabutuna o Isa aunto tee apogau, "Kembaia incia!" Manga incia akemba mia mawilo sumai tee apogau, "Pekatangkamea o incamu tee ubhangumo! Incia akembako."
Kasiimpo mia mawilo sumai alausaka arambasaka jubana tee apekadhei akakaro to alingka apokawaaka Isa.
Aabhamo o Isa, "Opea gaumu ipewauku to ingkoo?" Lawanina mia mawilo sumai, "E Guru, iaku gauku kupokamata."
Apogaumo o Isa, "Ingkoo utopauntomo minaaka i kapiimu sii-sii roonamo uparacaeaaku!" Lausaka uka o mia mawilo sumai amembalimo apokamata, kasiimpo incia aose Isa i nuncana lingkaana.
